verdict.rationale: Omnara's changelog says you can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause for input. That covers the core of controlling what an agent does without manual confirmation. It rests on one thin claim, though, with no evidence of distinct tiered autonomy levels. Missing for 10: documented tiered or preset autonomy levels, detail on how approval rules are configured (e.g. per tool or per agent config), independent or hands-on corroboration.
